final: WITH invoice_totals AS (SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_product_cost) / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM invoice_totals) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_count, i.cost_ratio / o.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_totals AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
